coverage_reviews.reason: The IGNTP transcription records surviving Greek in each of John 1:1–5 on page P1, with no separate correction reading inside those verse elements. Some letters are supplied as lost or illegible, so the positive status is partial. Captured NTVMR metadata labels indexed page ID 10 as folio 1; the index also lists these verses on unlabeled page ID 3. The NTVMR index alone is not physical proof.

coverage_reviews.reason: The inspected image shows surviving Greek for each of John 1:1-5 in the right column: verse 1 on lines 1-3, verse 2 on line 3, verse 3 on lines 4-6, verse 4 on lines 6-7, and verse 5 on lines 8-10.
